trial_policy: Materialized case×trial rows with stable example_id; Evaluation.trials=1. Runtime prediction UUIDs keep every attempt distinct.
recovery_policy: Existing run directories are never reused. Preserve per-turn, prediction and scored records on interruption; resume selected unfinished cases in a new explicitly named run.
assertion_fraction_scope: Valid judge verdicts only; failed judges remain failed cases and their assertions are reported as ungraded.

agent.scope: Standard Claude API list-price estimate for returned usage, including planning and verification. Excludes Weave Signals, offline evaluation judges, voice, hosting, taxes, and any usage not returned after failures or SDK/provider retries. Calls count application invocations, not every HTTP attempt. This is not an invoice. Research counts do not measure factual completeness.

judge.scope: Standard Claude API list-price estimate for returned usage, including planning and verification. Excludes Weave Signals, offline evaluation judges, voice, hosting, taxes, and any usage not returned after failures or SDK/provider retries. Calls count application invocations, not every HTTP attempt. This is not an invoice. Research counts do not measure factual completeness.

combined.scope: All saved agent-turn and judge calls, counted once. Includes unsuccessful/invalid outputs with returned usage; excludes Signals and unreturned charges.

budget.scope: Returned agent and judge usage at dated standard API prices. Conservative reservations before requests; SDK retries disabled by experiment adapters. Stops on unpriced usage or failed provider calls. Excludes Signals, hosting, taxes and unreturned charges. This is not an account billing cap.

budget_usage_reconciliation.scope: Only budget records created during this run, even when several arms share an outer budget. A provider return may precede a completed prediction/scorer receipt. Missing records remain here; their costs must not disappear from total experiment spending. Matching observed records does not establish an invoice or account for unreturned charges.
